reviews.review: An amazing game with massive amounts of replayability, I would highly recommend it.
This game gives me the feels especially went ur on ur way to 1-2 hour mark
Excellent game. Hours of replayability. Can be super easy to absurdly hard, you pick.

Good game but could use some quality of life touches like more zoom options, clearer item descriptions and some characters are nowhere near as good unless you get lucky with items (I'm looking at you bandit and HAN-D!), you can caught on ropes/ladders that you didn't mean to climb which can easily kill you if you're not careful, maybe adding a interact button to the ropes/ladders would help this but still a decent game and a nice way to kill time. Though I think the game might have stopped being updated because Risk of rain 2 will be coming out eventually and the devs might've stopped paying attention to the game, Overall I'd say a 8/10 game.

This is one of my favorite games, The first time I played, my friends brought over his PC, we all sat around and couldn't put it down. It has a very narutal flow; the item/map randomization gives each playthrough a unique feel.The difficulty timer gives the game a sence of urgency and pushes the player (Even after beating the game several times, It can still catch you off guard). Pairing great game mechanics with an awesome soundtrack and beautiful terrain make this masterpeice a real gem. The great replay value, reset after death mecahnic, and relativly short playthrough makes this game really easy to pick back up even if you haven't played for months. I don't have any major disslikes with the game, It would be really nice if it had a story mode, or even if the developers would make a similar game with some RPG elements but that is entirely personal preference and not a problem with the game. all of that aside it is a great game and for $10 it is absolutly worth it I would recomend it to everyone, It is great for everyone from beginners to even the most hardend players. easily a 9/10
